Assert that the success/confirmation message element is visible on the page. Should return boolean or raise assertion error if not visible.

Navigate to the Support Portal page. Should handle any redirects or page transitions and wait for the support portal page to fully load.
Locate the subject input field and enter the provided subject text. Should clear any existing text before input and verify text was entered successfully.
Locate the message/body text area and enter the provided message text. Should clear any existing text before input and verify text was entered successfully.
Locate and click the Submit button to send the support request. Should wait for button to be clickable and handle any loading states.
Wait for and locate the success confirmation message element after form submission. Should return the element or its locator for further validation.

missing_methods.intent: Assert confirmation text matches expected value
